string.name: onboarding_welcome_description
string.value: Let text, images, and files flow naturally between your trusted devices.

string.name: onboarding_sync_title
string.value: Create or join a sync space

string.name: onboarding_sync_description
string.value: Open Settings to create a space or scan an invitation. Devices in the same space can discover each other and start syncing.

string.name: onboarding_trusted_devices
string.value: Content only moves between devices you authorize

string.name: onboarding_history_description
string.value: Send content from Clipboard, then search, star, or pin desktop history so useful items stay close.

string.name: onboarding_history_text_note
string.value: Write it to this device's clipboard

string.name: onboarding_history_image_note
string.value: Pick them up on another device

string.name: onboarding_privacy_title
string.value: More than a clipboard, with privacy built in

string.name: onboarding_privacy_description
string.value: UniClipboard supports text, images, and files. Transfers use an encrypted space, while sensitive credentials stay in system secure storage.
